results.title: Gleap: Support Intelligence platform for SaaS companies. | Product Hunt
results.content:
Title: Gleap: Support Intelligence platform for SaaS companies. | Product Hunt
Gleap helps SaaS teams collect, structure, and act on support signals, from bug reports to code-level fixes. It transforms customer support tickets, bug reports, and in-app feedback into structured product insight, and helps teams act on that insight directly inside their development workflow. It becomes a real-time intelligence layer for product teams. Kai by GleapMeet Kai, Gleap’s AI-driven customer support hero. Gleap Knowledge BaseBuild your help center for lightning fast customer support. Reviewers describe Gleap as a flexible all-in-one support and feedback tool that is easy to use, polished, and backed by fast, helpful support. Users repeatedly highlight bug reporting, customer feedback collection, surveys, and the Kai chatbot, with one longtime customer saying Kai handles advanced support workflows better than Intercom’s Fin. Several also praise the steady pace of improvements and features like automatic screenshots, video capture, and knowledge base options. I've switched from Intercom to Gleap and it's been a fantastic experience. The features are top-notch, and the support team is always ready to assist. The co-founder's honesty and openness to feedback are admirable. A few areas could use improvement, such as the support documentation and the somewhat complicated user authentication during implementation. It's really a product with an incredible value. I started to use it last year mainly as a bug reporting tool, but since then, so many features were added and improved! I can say today that I have built a big part of my services around it: a click on my "contact" button triggers the Gleap widget! I just had few hours to test the knowledge base feature and I am already so exited to add it to my widgets : branding, cname, multilingual, SEO visibility : it has it all! multilingual support (1)bug reporting (3)screenshot bug reports (1)knowledge base feature (1). I use it for almost everything, like getting customer feedback, surveying them, and using chatbot KAI, and I love it. If you are in a team, marketing, customer support, or Qa, or want to get everyone on the same page, this is an ideal feedback tool. customer feedback (2)flexible use (2)AI chat support (1)integrated surveys (1).
